title: [Chapitre] VII. Analysis situs (troisième mouture) : notes manuscrites (23-26/06/1986).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting: Grothendieck's axiomatic 'analysis situs' (third version, June 1986). There is a set M of 'figures' with a symmetric 'disjointness' relation Z‖X. Supports are subsets of M defined through this relation: supp_M X = {Y : ∀Z, Z‖X ⇒ Z‖Y}, and cosupp_M A is the set of figures disjoint from A. Together they form a lattice Σ_M of supports. Each figure X has an ordered set of strata X̃, and ∂X = X̃ \ {X} = {Y < X}.

The previous page defines the 'open stratum' X° = supp_M X ∩ cosupp_M ∂X. This is an intrinsic substitute for X \ ∂X, defined purely through disjointness. Grothendieck wants supp X = Sup_{Σ} over Y ∈ X̃ of Y°: the closed support should be the union of the open strata of its faces, as for a CW/stratified space. This page translates that as: for every Z ∈ M, Z‖X ⇔ ∀Y ∈ X̃, Z‖Y°.

The direction ⇒ is clear, since Y° ⊂ supp Y ⊂ supp X and Z‖X ⇔ Z‖supp X. The question is the converse.

He sketches and then strikes out a 'provisional heuristic criterion' for Z‖Y°. It reads: there exist a subdivision Z' of Z and a sub-figure Z'_0 of Z' such that Z'_0 ≪ ∂Y ('lies within' ∂Y) and the complementary part 'Z' \ Z'_0' is disjoint from Y. This is the familiar picture: Z avoids the open cell Y° iff, after subdividing, Z splits into a piece inside ∂Y and a piece disjoint from the closed cell Y.

He then compares X° with supp(comb(X)°), where comb(X) is the 'combinatorial' model of X attached by the axioms. Claim (*): supp comb(X)° ⊂ X°. Proof:
- AtL2 gives supp comb(X) = supp X, so supp comb(X)° ⊂ supp X.
- AtL3 gives comb(X)° ‖ ∂X, so supp comb(X)° ⊂ cosupp ∂X.

He ends with 'A-t-on égalité?' The next page (26.6) abandons proving this from scratch. It instead introduces 'Ax supp 1': if Y ∈ X° then Y ≪ X. From this it deduces X° = {Y ∈ Omb(X) : Y_{∂X} = ∅}.

Purpose: building, from a purely relational/order-theoretic axiomatics, the stratified-space notion that a closed stratum is the union of the open strata of its faces. This is part of the 'tame topology' foundations announced in Esquisse d'un programme.
errors: No outright error. The proof of (*) depends on the unstated content of axioms AtL2/AtL3, which are not visible on this page.
The reverse implication (Z‖Y° for all faces Y ⇒ Z‖X) is left open here. It is effectively replaced by a new axiom on the next page rather than proved.
The heuristic criterion is crossed out. 'Z'·Z'_0' is presumably meant as the complement Z' \ Z'_0, so the notation there is informal.

ideas.what: Supports defined as Galois-closed sets for a symmetric disjointness relation on figures, forming a lattice Σ_M
ideas.where_published: Only in the spirit of the tame-topology section of Esquisse d'un programme (1984); not as stated here

ideas.what: Intrinsic open stratum X° = supp X ∩ cosupp ∂X, and the requirement that supp X be the sup of the open strata of the faces
ideas.modern_name: Open cells/strata of a stratified space or regular CW complex; closure-finite stratification

ideas.what: Heuristic criterion: Z misses the open cell Y° iff, after subdivision, Z splits into a part inside ∂Y and a part disjoint from Y
ideas.modern_name: Subdivision/general position argument in PL topology or o-minimal cell decomposition
ideas.usually_credited_to: Classical PL topology; van den Dries (o-minimal cell decomposition)

ideas.what: Comparison of the interior of the combinatorial model comb(X) with X°, with inclusion proved from axioms AtL2/AtL3
ideas.modern_name: Triangulation/combinatorial model of a tame set compatible with strata
ideas.usually_credited_to: o-minimal triangulation theorem (van den Dries, Shiota)

missed.claim: The question of equality supp comb(X)° = X°, and of whether the open strata reconstruct supp X, is left open here. It is then resolved by fiat (a new axiom, Ax supp 1) on the next page. The program of an axiomatic, purely relational analysis situs with an intrinsic notion of open stratum was never completed or published.
missed.quote: Je dis que (*). supp comb(X)° ⊂ X° ... A-t-on égalité?
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: This is of mild interest for axiomatic or 'synthetic' tame topology, and for comparisons with o-minimality or stratified-space frameworks. However, the content on this page is standard in spirit.

deep.surprise_reason: This is a routine working page in Grothendieck's unpublished axiomatic tame-topology project. The ideas (Galois-closed supports, open strata as support minus boundary support, union of open faces) are elementary analogues of standard stratified-space facts. The only historically interesting aspect is the unpublished axiomatic framework as a whole, not anything specific to this page.
transcription_corrections: 'comme ∂X' should read 'cosupp ∂X' (the line is 'à voir que supp comb(X)° est contenu dans cosupp ∂X, i.e. comb(X)° ‖ ∂X').
'Je proposerai la critère heuristique provisoire' should read 'Je proposerais le critère heuristique provisoire'. The whole boxed block is struck through with diagonal lines.
'subdivisions Z^!_∘ de Z', Z' de Z, et une sous-figure' should read: a subdivision Z' of Z and a sub-figure Z'_0 of Z' (with Z'_0 ≪ ∂Y and 'Z'·Z'_0' ‖ Y).
The insertion above 'puisqu'on sait que' reads 'en prenant' (or similar), with 'AtL2' written below it. The crossed-out word is 'Conséquence de AtL2'.
In the last line, 'Ainsi' is crossed out, followed by 'A-t-on égalité?'.
